mentions.quote: maintained on warfarin 5 mg PO daily
Bridge with enoxaparin 1 mg/kg SC q12h starting 3 days prior, last dose 24 hours pre-op. Resume warfarin ... with enoxaparin bridging restarted 48-72 hours post-op until INR is therapeutic

post_op.quote: Resume warfarin at the usual home dose the evening of surgery if hemostasis is adequate, with enoxaparin bridging restarted 48-72 hours post-op until INR is therapeutic

pre_op.quote: Stop warfarin 5 days before surgery (last dose 03/13/2026); check INR the day before surgery with goal <1.5. Bridge with enoxaparin 1 mg/kg SC q12h starting 3 days prior, last dose 24 hours pre-op
